description: This file defines a utility enum `WebViewJavaScriptSupport` with static methods to inject JavaScript into a WKWebView, manage debugging status, evaluate JavaScript to a string asynchronously, and serialize Swift values to JavaScript string literals.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to set debug status and optional status messages via a JavaScript API exposed to the web content.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates JavaScript code in the web view and returns the result as a String, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Serializes an optional String into a JavaScript-compatible string literal, escaping as needed.
